in_marathi.name: Dhanvin
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wealth, Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanvin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhanvin means 'God of Wealth, Prosperity'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dhanu', which means 'bow' or 'weapon'. The prefix 'Vin' means 'God'. Thus, Dhanvin signifies the deity of wealth and prosperity, who is believed to bestow his blessings upon his devotees.
